The helper validation, renderer check, and native batch dry-run passed; these blocking review findings remain.

1. The enforced `suite-clock` excludes the required provenance test step, so it cannot establish REQ-01’s 30-second bound while preserving all required validation coverage. The plan measures only nextest plus doctests ([plan.md:19](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/4b7c06d0-test-suite-performance/plan.md:19)), but `cargo-ci` always runs ignored provenance tests afterward and documents a 3–4 minute cost ([cargo-ci.sh:315](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/scripts/cargo-ci.sh:315)). Include every required test execution in the enforced clock and give that full path a credible under-30-second design, or obtain an explicit container-criterion change that excludes provenance.

2. `stale-binary-fixture` promises an observable nextest run but has no dependency on `nextest-foundation` ([breakdown.json:223](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/4b7c06d0-test-suite-performance/breakdown.json:223), [breakdown.json:236](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/4b7c06d0-test-suite-performance/breakdown.json:236)). Its own `cargo-ci` gate still uses `cargo test` until the runner swap, so it cannot independently verify its nextest criterion against the pinned, committed configuration. Add `nextest-foundation` as a dependency of this leaf.

3. `nextest-foundation` mixes a foundation/configuration/CI implementation with contributor documentation ([breakdown.json:301](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/4b7c06d0-test-suite-performance/breakdown.json:301)). Split the `dev/TESTING.md` guidance into a documentation consumer after the foundation’s pinned executable and config are established; keep the foundation leaf to the configuration, CI provision, and parse-validation boundary.

4. The transaction benchmark JSON is an undeclared cross-task contract. `transaction-benchmark` creates it, `fsync-dedupe` updates it, and attribution consumes it ([breakdown.json:136](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/4b7c06d0-test-suite-performance/breakdown.json:136), [breakdown.json:526](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/dev/active/4b7c06d0-test-suite-performance/breakdown.json:526)), yet the plan declares no producer/consumer contract for it. Define immutable measurement evidence with exactly one producer, then a separate fsync-decision evidence contract if needed; declare each consumer and rewire dependencies accordingly.
